title: Embrace Outsider Ideas
description: When evaluating external ideas: - Ask: "Is this idea or product effective, regardless of where it came from?" - Compare: Assess its potential objectively against internal solutions. - Collaborate: Consider how external knowledge might complement your existing methods. Example: Your team resists using an external tool because it’s not developed in-house. Challenge this by focusing on its benefits and efficiency.
